Sr. Pre-qualification Criteria

i. The bidder should have supplied PT/DPT’s in any chemicals and Fertilizer Units in last 7 years. The P.O copy should be provided with the details like specifications of the supplied items with simil ar to our requirement. - As a documentary proof, the bidder must submit PO copy/copies fulfilling above criteria along with its proof of execution i.e. compl etion certificate or invoice copy with payment advice. ii. In case if vendor is not OEM, the necessary certificate from princip als for supply & services is to be submitted. Following documents shall be required to demonstrate experience in c 1 ompletion of similar items: 1. Copy of the Purchase Order (PO) / Work Order / Contract for the sup ply of similar items shall be issued and executed within the last seven (7) years. 2. Proof of execution of the submitted PO, which may include any of th e following: a. Completion certificate / Customer Acceptance Certificate OR b. GeM CRAC (Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate) docume nt OR c. (i). Tax Invoice and (ii). Proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the above re ferred tax invoice. The document submitted as proof of execution must be specifically for the same concerned Purchase Order (PO)/Work Order/Contract submit ted, clearly indicating the corresponding PO/Work Order/Contract num ber.

Financial: - A) Turnover / audited annual reports: Last three years financial audited reports or Turnover certificate from Chartered Accountant (CA) as below: Average Annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the previous financial year (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) should be at least (Required minimum Avg. turnover of Rs. 12.94 Lak hs). The Turnover should be issued by practicing CA with Membership Num ber, seal and signed with UDIN. Bidder shall submit audited annual reports certified by Chartered Acco untant (CA) or Turnover certificates for above financial years. Turnover certificates should be issued by practicing CA with membership numbe 2 r, seal and signed. Certificate / document issued by Chartered Account ant will be valid and accepted only with UDIN number. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less tha n 3 years old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financi al years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account. In thi s case, the financial turnover during last financial year / the average fi nancial turnover during preceding two financial years should be at le ast Rs. 12.94 lakhs. i. Relaxation in financial criteria for eligible MSEs 1. For MSEs- Relaxation of 25% in Annual financial turnover shall be provided to the qualifying MSEs. ii. Relaxation in financial criteria for eligible startup as per attached annexure.

Successful bidder will have to submit the Security Depos it (SD) for 5% of total contract value within 14 days f rom receipt of P.O in the form of bank guarantee as per RCF format from RCF’s approved list of Bankers coverin g the delivery period plus 2 months. SPECIAL NOTE: Security Dep A) If the SD is not deposited within the stipulated 14-day osit period, the SD will be recovered along with Interest from the due date of Deposit from the first payment. The inte rest rate shall be the applicable Secured Overnight Fina 3 ncing Rate (SOFR) + 2% or MCLR (6 months) + 2% as a pplicable. Successful bidder will have to submit Performance Bank Guarantee for same value as that of Security deposit wit hin 15 days from the date of supply of material in the for Performance m of bank guarantee as per RCF format from RCF appro BG for supply ved banker covering the period of 26 months from the date of supply. SD submitted in the form of Bank guaran tee can be converted in to PBG. Bidder shall furnish warranty certificate for a period of 1 Warrantee P 8 months from the date of supply or 12 months from the 4 eriod date of commissioning whichever is earlier against any manufacturing defects. As per revision dt 16.09.2021 of ‘Public Procurement pol icy 2017’, Non-local suppliers cannot participate in tend ers having estimates less than Rs. 200 crores. Offers of Class-I and Class-II Local suppliers as per Make in In Make In India 5 dia policy can only be considered for evaluation and aw Declaration: ard of contract. The document (Self Declaration) should be given on bidders letter head and should specify GeM Tender ID, Percentage of local content and Location (fac tory address) of local value addition. NOTE: i) Bidder should accept technical Specifications for PT/DPT as per T echnical bid only. Any deviation will be seriously viewed, unacceptable deviations if not corrected in time limit provided by RCF, the proposal i s liable to rejected. ii) The bidder should submit Complete Technical Details of Product Manufactured along with the Product Catalogue indicating all technical specifications. Following document to be submitted along with your offer: 1. PO copy and other supporting documents as per PQC 2. Turnover proofs as per PQC with UDIN.

3. Duly filled, signed and stamped copy ofM ake In India declar ation with % of local content, location of value addition a nd GEM Tender ID. 4. Duly filled, signed and stamped copy of Technical bid and ATC documents. Payment terms for MSME Bidders: i) In respect of suppliers registered as Micro or Small Enterprises under the MSMED Act, 2006 and holding a valid Udyam Registration Certificate, payment shall be rele ased on any one of the Treds Platform registered with RBI as decided by RCF. (ii) In case the Bidder has opted for discounting of the Invoice through any on e of the RBI registered platforms then the payment will be released on such platform as decided by the Contractor. Grievances during Tendering Process : · Any supplier, contractor, or consultant who claims to have suffered o r is likely to suffer loss or injury due to a decision, action, or omission by RCF, may submit a review application to the following e-Mail ID : GC- THAL-PUR@rcfltd.com · The review application against subject tender can only be submitted by bidder who have applied against tender. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 1. The rates quoted shall be inclusive of TPI charges, all taxes (GST also), d uties, freight, Insurance and any other statutory charges. 2.
